episode.name: md_sector_humanoid_sensors_2026-05-16
episode.source_desc: Sector overview: 人形机器人传感器板块综述_2026-05-16.md

entities.name: Humanoid Robot Sensors
entities.summary: Humanoid-robot sensor subsystem — 20-25% of BOM, the most value-dense non-mechanical subsystem. 2030 China sensor TAM ≈ ¥119 bn (CAGR ≈60% from 2024). Five sub-segments: 6-axis force, 1-axis force, flexible tactile / e-skin, 3D vision, IMU + encoders. Per-robot sensor BOM ~¥89,600 (Optimus reference).

entities.name: Anpeilong
entities.summary: 安培龙 (SZSE:301413). Ceramic-platform sensor company across thermistor, ceramic-capacitive pressure, MEMS pressure, oxygen/NOx, and force. FY2025 revenue ¥1.18 bn (+26%); net profit ¥91 m (+10%). Auto cash cow + humanoid force-sensor option; 6-axis force at A-sample stage, ¥60.4 m capex line (500k units/yr) due 2026. Founder 邬若军 personally heading force-sensor unit.

entities.name: Hanwei Technology
entities.summary: 汉威科技 (SZSE:300007). Domestic #1 gas-sensor leader + smart solutions + flexible tactile via subsidiary Suzhou NSDA (能斯达). FY2024 revenue ¥2.23 bn (-2.6%) with 41% profit drop — legacy drag — but the tactile pure-play. NSDA covers piezo-resistive + piezo-electric + capacitive + sweat routes (most-complete in industry); engaged with Tesla Optimus on B-sample validation (largest single sector catalyst). PE(TTM) ~210×.

entities.name: Fulai New Materials
entities.summary: 福莱新材 (SSE:605488). Functional-coating materials maker (Zhejiang) entering tactile sensors via subsidiary Suzhou Fulaiying (福莱盈). FY2024 revenue ¥2.54 bn (+19%); net profit ¥139 m (+98%). Piezo-resistive route aligned with Tesla Optimus; 3D flexible-circuit hetero-integration captures pressure + temperature simultaneously. Customers already shipping: 元橙 (Yuancheng), 灵心 (LingXin) dexterous hand, 兆威机电 (Zhaowei), Fourier. Set up US subsidiary Sep-2025. PE(TTM) ~65× — sector low.

entities.name: Orbbec
entities.summary: 奥比中光 (SSE:688322). World #2 3D-vision sensor platform — proprietary MX-series depth-engine ASICs + full 6-route stack (structured light, iToF, dToF, stereo, LiDAR, industrial 3D metrology). FY2025 revenue ¥0.94 bn (+67%); first annual profit ¥128 m. 5 million 3D sensors shipped to 1,000+ robotics OEMs; >70% China service-robot 3D-vision share. PE(TTM) ~300× — sector highest.

entities.name: Suzhou NSDA
entities.summary: 苏州能斯达. Hanwei 64%-owned subsidiary; A-share's earliest, largest-capacity, most-complete flexible-tactile-sensor player. 0.1 kPa sensitivity (10× human threshold). 3 m units/yr capacity in 2025. Engaged with Tesla Optimus team — 12 tactile points; 2025 Q3 B-sample validation milestone.

entities.name: Suzhou Fulaiying
entities.summary: 苏州福莱盈电子. Fulai 100%-owned subsidiary; piezo-resistive flexible-tactile sensor maker. Product matrix FOS-P300 / P300T / P300S / W500 (full-hand). Strategic partnership with Zhaowei (兆威机电) Jul-2025; passed North-American customer certification 2025.

entities.name: Bluepoint Touch
entities.summary: 蓝点触控. Chinese 6-axis force-sensor maker — held 72.6% of humanoid 6-axis force-sensor sub-segment in 2025, despite only ~4.8% of broader China share. Key supplier to Tesla Optimus, Unitree, Agibot.

entities.name: ATI Industrial Automation
entities.summary: US-based 6-axis force-sensor leader — ~50% China high-end share. Early Optimus sample supplier; also Figure.

entities.name: Keli Sensing
entities.summary: 柯力传感 (SSE:603662). New entrant in humanoid force sensors; Optimus 2025 H1 sample / Q3 certification / 500 sets full-year target. Also serves Agibot and Unitree at production scale.

entities.name: HONOR

entities.name: X-Humanoid

entities.name: Pollen Robotics

entities.name: Dahua

entities.name: Huawei

entities.name: Ant Group

entities.name: Stellantis

entities.name: NIO

entities.name: Li Auto
entities.summary: 理想汽车. Chinese EV maker; Anpeilong sensor customer.

entities.name: Midea
entities.summary: 美的集团 (SZSE:000333). Major appliance maker; Anpeilong customer and humanoid investor.

entities.name: Keurig Dr Pepper
entities.summary: Beverage company — Anpeilong sensor customer outside auto.

entities.name: Jiangsu Dinghui Embodied AI Center
entities.summary: 江苏鼎汇具身智能机器人创新中心. Anpeilong took a stake to access China humanoid customers.

entities.name: Tesla
entities.summary: 美国 EV + 机器人 OEM. Inferred to be 'major North-American NEV customer' representing 15.95% of Anpeilong FY2025 revenue. Optimus B-sample validation is the sector's biggest single catalyst. Tesla self-develops the Optimus vision stack so Orbbec is excluded.

entities.name: 6-axis Force Sensor
entities.summary: Six-axis force/torque sensor — 4 units per humanoid (wrists+ankles) + 14 torque sensors at ¥3-8k each. ¥138 bn cumulative China TAM 2024-30. Key humanoid sub-segment, ~45% of perception BOM.

entities.name: Flexible Tactile Sensor
entities.summary: Electronic-skin / flexible tactile sensor — 10-30 contact points per humanoid at ¥100-1,000 each. Cumulative ¥80-120 bn TAM 2024-30, highest CAGR ≈90%. Engineering on the eve of mass-production.

entities.name: 3D Vision Sensor
entities.summary: 3D vision sensor — 2-4 per humanoid (head + wrists) at ¥2-5k each. Cumulative ¥40-60 bn TAM 2024-30; faces OEM-self-developed-vision pressure (Tesla) and 2D-camera-leader entry (Hikvision, Dahua).
